thread:
mira: Hey team, after the RBAC change rollout (PR#4523) some users report SSO failures — getting `401` and the IdP logs show 'Audience URI mismatch' for saml assertion from corp-aad. Also SCIM shows duplicate group assignments for ~30 users. Anyone else seeing this?

jamal: On it. Which IdP/tenant? corp-aad or partners?

mira: corp-aad primary tenant. We rotated the KMS key earlier today for token encryption — not sure if related. Rollout started at ~11:10 UTC.

alex: Quick checklist: 1) did we change EntityID/Identifier on the AAD Enterprise App? 2) did the AssertionConsumerService (ACS) URL change? 3) SCIM patch schema changes?

lena: I can join the tenant to check the app config. Mir a — can you paste the raw SAMLResponse from a failing login (redact PII)?

mira: Pasting minimal redacted snippet from the idp logs: `SAMLResponse: Issuer="https://sts.windows.net/<tenant>/" Audience="https://redwood-inference/api/saml"` The app expects `https://redwood-inference/` (no /api/saml). So yeah audience mismatch.

jamal: That explains the 401. AAD sends Audience based on the Identifier (Entity ID) field on the Enterprise App. Someone must have changed it during the RBAC rollout script that updated app manifests.

alex: Repro steps to fix in AAD portal: Enterprise Applications -> our app -> Single sign-on (SAML) -> Edit Identifier (Entity ID) to `https://redwood-inference/` and Reply URL to `https://redwood-inference/saml/acs`. Also ensure Logout URL matches. I can do a canary change in 10m.

mira: Meanwhile SCIM duplicates: looks like the SCIM sync started creating new group entries because externalId normalization changed in PR#4523 (we started lowercasing externalId for back-compat). Two groups now map to same externalId => duplicate assignments. Example: `externalId: eng-Platform` vs `eng-platform` both treated as same after normalization but SCIM create logic didn't dedupe existing groups.

lena: Oof. So two problems from same rollout. For SCIM quick mitigation: block SCIM provisioning by disabling provisioning in AAD for the app (set to "Sync Off") until we remediate. That will stop new duplicates.

jamal: Agreed. I'll disable provisioning now.

sre-bot: provisioning change detected by audit: corp-aad -> provisioningStatus: Suspended by jamal at 2026-03-20T11:28:45Z

alex: After disabling, we should run a cleanup script to merge duplicate group records and reassign memberships. I have a script snippet: 
``` 
# list potential dup groups
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood-inference/internal/v1/orgs/<org>/groups" | jq -r '.[] | [.id, .displayName, .externalId] | @tsv' | sort -f -t '\t' -k3
```
Use that to find groups with same externalId ignoring case.

mira: Also KMS: the SAML assertions are encrypted with the KMS key. We rotated key earlier; if the IdP or runtime still expects old key, decryption fails differently. But our logs show Audience mismatch before decryption error, so KMS rotation probably unrelated for this symptom. Still worth verifying key alias mapping.

alex: Check runtime key mapping: `kms.describe-key --alias redwood/saml-enc` and ensure alias points to the new key id. If we have an old key in env var SAML_KMS_KEY_ID that wasn't updated in dedicated runtime config, that could surface as separate failures.

mira: I checked: alias updated correctly. SAML_KMS_KEY_ID in hosted runtime got auto-updated by deployment job. Dedicated nodes may have cached env; I pushed a config refresh to dedicated pool.

jamal: Canary change to AAD Identifier applied. Testing login now.

idp-bot: TestLogin result: user=jamal.a success via SAML, Audience matched. (test-id 9842)

mira: Confirmed login success for one user. Can others try?

lena: I can login. Works for me.

mira: Ok keep provisioning suspended while we plan cleanup. For cleanup plan: 1) find duplicate groups by externalId ignoring case 2) choose canonical ID (prefer existing with most members) 3) reassign memberships and delete empty duplicate group 4) run in dry-run mode then schedule full run in 2h off-peak.

alex: I'll prepare a dry-run script and post PR for approval. Also we should add a validation to SCIM import that checks for externalId collisions pre-change. Make it fail fast with a warning in console.

jamal: Incident notes for postmortem: root cause = RBAC rollout (PR#4523) introduced externalId normalization + app manifest change during same deployment window -> caused AAD Identifier mismatch and SCIM duplicate creation. Mitigation = rolled back manifest to correct Identifier, disabled provisioning, canary test, config refresh for dedicated KMS env, scheduled group dedupe.

mira: Adding severity and timeline to incidents channel. I'll create the postmortem draft. Please add timestamps for your actions.

lena: FYI: AAD admin audit shows manifest update by automation user `infra-bot@redwood` at 11:12 UTC — we'll add a guardrail to require manual approval for identity-manifest changes.

alex: Also adding automated smoke test: periodic SAML test logins from multiple tenants and a SCIM idempotency check that fails the deploy if duplicates would be created.

mira: Thanks all. After cleanup we'll re-enable provisioning and monitor for 24h. :white_check_mark: 

jamal: I'll update the ticket and mark the incident as mitigated for now.

sre-bot: Incident mitigated by jamal at 2026-03-20T11:45:12Z.

mira: Closing thread here — continue on the postmortem doc.
